attributes:
/.gitattributes text eol=lf
/.scriptkit-generator/.gitignore text eol=lf
/.scriptkit-generator/manifest.json text eol=lf
/tool.json text eol=lf
/pyproject.toml text eol=lf
/$launcher text eol=lf
handler:
"""User-owned command logic. ScriptKit never overwrites this file."""


def run(command, arguments):
    """Implement commands here; return an integer exit status."""
    raise NotImplementedError(command)
project:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = $name
version = $version
description = $description
requires-python = $python

[project.scripts]
$name = $entrypoint

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
